evidence.snippet: You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
The following limits apply depending on your Zendesk Suite plan type.

decisions.reason: API access beyond the 14-day trial requires a paid Zendesk Suite/Support plan, so continued production use is gated by payment.

evidence.snippet: You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
An OAuth token gives access to a single Zendesk instance (the one with the OAuth client used to create the token).

decisions.reason: A documented REST API with OAuth/API-token auth is usable today, but only via a time-limited trial before a paid plan is required for ongoing use, hence caveats rather than fully free.
